sentence: This project builds a computer pipeline driven by data to study how cell morphology controls signaling in cancer cells.
This project tries to find where arginylation, a change added to proteins, happens in cardiovascular proteins and what it does.
This project studies what drives exercise pressor reflex dysfunction in primary hypertension, looking at signaling changes within the dorsal root ganglion.
This project collects fresh tissue and processes it for research, including single-cell dissociation and plasma processing.
This project tries to find out how metal ions interact with the immune system and builds delivery systems to use those interactions.
This project tests a strategy for generating neurons from glial cells and studies how they affect bladder function after spinal cord injury.
This project studies how Clostridioides difficile colonization turns into disease, using stool samples and looking at gut microbiome and host factors.
This project tries to find out whether an RNA binding protein drives and maintains basal-squamous pancreas cancer.
This project tests a point-of-care oral cytology tool for monitoring patients at high risk of oral cavity cancer over time.
This project studies how environmental stress damages and shortens telomeres, and which pathways protect damaged telomeres.
This project builds a mouse model of mitochondrial diseases and develops a gene therapy that uses an adeno-associated virus.
This project studies how the airway epithelium develops in infants and how respiratory viral infection changes it and relates to asthma.
This project provides a web-based platform where researchers can enter non-coding variants and order mouse models or human pluripotent stem cell models.
This project develops a targeted delivery method that uses microbubbles and focused ultrasound to release therapeutic agents in the liver.
This project develops and tests a mobile-phone-based retinal camera to screen for type 2 diabetes and diabetic retinopathy.
This project studies how a receptor protein and its pathways help the urothelium stay healthy and regenerate after chronic injury.
This project tries to find genes linked to cocaine addiction using mouse genetic tools and computational methods.
This project tests how much peanut children with peanut allergy can ingest before they react, to help select treatment.
This project studies endometrial cancer biology to find approaches to prevent and treat this disease.
